svg.aria-label: A 16 by 4 binary mask stored as 64 bytes and as eight 8-bit words, with eight pixels of one row expanded both ways: eight bytes of which one bit each carries the image, and one 8-bit word
svg.text: 64 bits stored. One bit in each byte carries the pixel;
the other seven, drawn grey, are always zero.
8 bits stored. Pixel x is bit x of the row.
Pixel 0 is the lowest bit, so the number reads right to left.
Drawn with 8-bit words for legibility; the default word is uint32_t, 32 pixels.
